sloka: पुष्प भार समृद्धानि शिखराणि समन्ततः ।लताभिः पुष्पित अग्राभिः उपगूढानि सर्वतः ॥४-१-९॥
transliteration: puṣpa bhāra samṛddhāni śikharāṇi samantataḥ ।latābhiḥ puṣpita agrābhiḥ upagūḍhāni sarvataḥ ॥4-1-9॥

translations.english: Entwined with flowering creepers the treetops are covered all over with rich loads of flowers.
